Symbol,Ⓒs.ⒹcihnaM, lakzaRaM, liMgaM, saMjYA, pratirUpaM.

Ⓝ[Sympath]ize,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓsaha-sama-duH-Kin a. BU &c.; See (s.); ‘I s(ympathize) with you in your distress’ tvadduHKaduHKitohaM; tvatsamaduHKaBAgahaM; ‘many s(ympathize) with as in our success’ bahavaH asmadaByudayena suKaBAjo BavaMti-modaMte-prIyaMte &c.

Symphony,Ⓒs.ⒹekatAnatA, svarEkyaM, sAmyaM; See Harmony.
